title: Adult Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) & AED Protocol
goal: Maintain vital cerebral and myocardial perfusion in an unresponsive victim of sudden cardiac arrest until defibrillation or EMS arrives.
steps_json: [{"step_number": 1, "title": "Scene Safety & Responsiveness Check", "instruction": "Verify the scene is safe for rescuers. Tap victim's shoulders firmly and shout 'Are you okay?'. Check for normal breathing for no more than 10 seconds.", "expected_outcome": "Determination of unresponsiveness and absent/agonal breathing."}, {"step_number": 2, "title": "Activate Emergency Response & Retrieve AED", "instruction": "Direct a specific bystander to call local emergency services (911/112) and retrieve an Automated External Defibrillator (AED).", "expected_outcome": "EMS dispatch activated and AED en route."}, {"step_number": 3, "title": "Position Hands on Center of Chest", "instruction": "Place heel of one hand on lower half of breastbone (sternum); interlock fingers of other hand on top. Lock elbows straight directly above victim's chest.", "expected_outcome": "Mechanical alignment for efficient bodyweight compressions."}, {"step_number": 4, "title": "High-Quality Chest Compressions", "instruction": "Compress chest at rate of 100-120 beats per minute (to tempo of 'Stayin' Alive') to depth of at least 2 inches (5 cm) but no more than 2.4 inches (6 cm). Allow full chest recoil between compressions without leaning.", "expected_outcome": "Artificially generates ~25-30% of normal cardiac output, maintaining brain oxygenation."}, {"step_number": 5, "title": "Deploy AED Immediately Upon Arrival", "instruction": "Power on AED, follow voice prompts, adhere pads to bare chest (upper right, lower left side), stand clear during rhythm analysis, and deliver shock if prompted before immediately resuming compressions.", "expected_outcome": "Terminates ventricular fibrillation (VF) through synchronous electrical depolarization."}]
verification_step: Check for return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC), coughing, movement, or arrival of advanced emergency medical personnel.
troubleshooting_notes: If the chest fails to rise during rescue breaths, reposition the airway (head-tilt, chin-lift) to clear tongue obstruction; if AED pads are wet, dry chest vigorously before pad placement.

title: Binary Search Algorithm Execution
goal: Locate target value within a sorted array in O(log n) logarithmic time complexity.
steps_json: [{"step_number": 1, "title": "Verify Sorted Precondition", "instruction": "Ensure array elements are in monotonically increasing order.", "expected_outcome": "Guarantees divide-and-conquer elimination property holds."}, {"step_number": 2, "title": "Initialize Boundary Pointers", "instruction": "Set low pointer = 0 and high pointer = length - 1.", "expected_outcome": "Defines active search window covering entire array."}, {"step_number": 3, "title": "Calculate Safe Midpoint", "instruction": "Compute mid = low + ((high - low) // 2) to avoid potential 32-bit integer overflow.", "expected_outcome": "Index of middle element of current subarray."}, {"step_number": 4, "title": "Evaluate Target Match", "instruction": "Compare array[mid] with target: if equal, return mid index.", "expected_outcome": "Target found immediately."}, {"step_number": 5, "title": "Halve Search Interval", "instruction": "If array[mid] < target, set low = mid + 1; else set high = mid - 1. Repeat from Step 3 while low <= high.", "expected_outcome": "Discards half of remaining search space per step."}, {"step_number": 6, "title": "Handle Target Absence", "instruction": "If loop terminates with low > high without match, return -1 (not found).", "expected_outcome": "Definitive conclusion target is absent."}]
verification_step: Confirm returned index holds target value: array[index] === target.
troubleshooting_notes: Using `mid = (low + high) / 2` can cause integer overflow in languages with fixed-width integers; off-by-one errors occur if `<` is used instead of `<=` in while condition.

title: The Empirical Scientific Method
goal: Systematically formulate, test, and validate an objective explanation for natural phenomena.
steps_json: [{"step_number": 1, "title": "Systematic Observation", "instruction": "Identify an unexplained phenomenon and gather existing quantitative measurements and literature.", "expected_outcome": "Clear, measurable research question."}, {"step_number": 2, "title": "Formulate Falsifiable Hypothesis", "instruction": "Propose a testable mechanism that predicts specific observable consequences that could be proven wrong.", "expected_outcome": "Empirically testable proposition with defined null and alternative hypotheses."}, {"step_number": 3, "title": "Design Controlled Experiment", "instruction": "Isolate the independent variable, establish control groups, and keep all extraneous variables constant.", "expected_outcome": "Experimental setup minimizing confounding factors and bias."}, {"step_number": 4, "title": "Data Collection & Replication", "instruction": "Conduct trials with sufficient sample size; record measurements blind to avoid experimenter expectancy bias.", "expected_outcome": "Statistically robust raw dataset."}, {"step_number": 5, "title": "Statistical Analysis & Conclusion", "instruction": "Perform statistical significance tests (p-values, effect sizes). Accept or reject null hypothesis.", "expected_outcome": "Corroboration or falsification of hypothesis leading to iterative refinement."}]
verification_step: Peer-reviewed independent replication of findings by external laboratories.
troubleshooting_notes: Beware of p-hacking (running multiple statistical tests until one produces p < 0.05 by chance) and confirmation bias (ignoring contradictory data).

title: Domestic Branch Circuit Troubleshooting & Safety Isolation
goal: Safely locate and remedy a tripped circuit breaker or ground fault in domestic electrical wiring.
steps_json: [{"step_number": 1, "title": "Verify Zero Voltage (Safety First)", "instruction": "Wear insulated footwear and use an approved Non-Contact Voltage Tester (NCVT) to confirm circuit is fully de-energized before touching wires.", "expected_outcome": "Verification that conductor carries 0 Volts AC."}, {"step_number": 2, "title": "Inspect Main Electrical Panel", "instruction": "Locate tripped breaker (handle rests in middle position between ON and OFF).", "expected_outcome": "Identifies affected branch circuit."}, {"step_number": 3, "title": "Unplug All Loads on Circuit", "instruction": "Disconnect all appliances, chargers, and lamps from all receptacles served by that breaker.", "expected_outcome": "Distinguishes external device fault from permanent behind-the-wall wiring short."}, {"step_number": 4, "title": "Reset Breaker", "instruction": "Push breaker handle firmly to the full OFF position until it clicks, then push firmly to the full ON position.", "expected_outcome": "Resets the internal bimetallic/magnetic trip latch mechanism."}, {"step_number": 5, "title": "Isolate Fault Source", "instruction": "If breaker trips immediately with nothing plugged in: wiring short circuit exists. If it holds, plug in devices one by one until breaker trips to identify faulty appliance.", "expected_outcome": "Pinpoints the exact source of overcurrent or ground fault."}]
verification_step: Circuit breaker remains energized under normal load; receptacle tester confirms correct hot, neutral, and ground polarity.
troubleshooting_notes: Never replace a 15-Amp breaker with a 20-Amp breaker to stop tripping—this can cause 14 AWG wire behind walls to overheat and ignite house fires.
